data.indexFullNameCn: 中证人工智能主题指数
data.indexCnDesc: 中证人工智能主题指数选取50只业务涉及为人工智能提供基础资源、技术以及应用支持的上市公司证券作为指数样本，以反映人工智能主题上市公司证券的整体表现。
data.indexEnDesc: CSI Artificial Intelligence Index selects 50 securities which provide the basic resources, technical and applications support for artificial intelligence. The index is to measure the performance of securities of listed companies which belongs to the theme.
